# Lucky

![Lucky](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/lucky.png)

Heads: 2 points, and it goes back into the pile to play again.

- **Rarity:** Common
- **Heads chance:** 30%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 2 points, Goes back into the pile

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** none
